rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. As in the earlier ruling on classm.retirement.9: box 1 is $0, so line 5a is $0 whether or not the entry is shown (amount_a agrees); the project shows it because box 5 ($545.00) is nonzero on a plan distribution outside the Simplified Method, i1040gi p. 28, Partially Taxable Pensions and Annuities.

Ruling: helper of a branch this entry does not take; project retained. The entry is a traditional IRA distribution (retirement.annuity is false), whose taxable amount is the IRA route's figure, $27,508.00 (retirement.taxable, which agrees); the Simplified Method helper is figured for every entry but read only for an annuity with cost. Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.

Ruling: helper of a branch this entry does not take; project retained. The entry is a plan distribution outside the Simplified Method (retirement.annuity is false), whose taxable amount is box 1 less box 5, $38,511.00 (retirement.plan_taxable and retirement.taxable, which agree); the Simplified Method helper (worksheet line 9, $31,376.00, while cost is left) is figured for every entry but read only for an annuity (retirement.plan_taxable). Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.

Ruling: helper of a branch this entry does not take; project retained. The entry is not an IRA distribution (retirement.is_ira is no, agreed); the IRA helper, box 1 less the amount rolled over ($41,168.00), is figured for every entry but read only for an IRA (retirement.taxable), and the taxable amount, $38,511.00, agrees. Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.

Ruling: helper of a branch this entry does not take; project retained. The entry is a Simplified Method annuity from a plan (retirement.is_ira is no, agreed); the IRA helper, box 1 less the amount rolled over ($34,952.00), is figured for every entry but read only for an IRA (retirement.taxable), and the taxable amount, $28,774.04, agrees. Dropped from the fixture as not evidence.

Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. Box 1 is $0, so line 5a is $0 whether or not the entry is shown; the project shows it because box 5 is nonzero on a plan distribution outside the Simplified Method.
